legend: Accidentally_Coder, a renowned coder from CSEland, is in a dilemma – she wants to give her friend, The_Author, a special gift. After thinking for a while, she went to her favorite shop at Zindabazar and bought an empty matrix A$$$A$$$ of size n×n$$$n \times n$$$. She knows that her friend loves numbers which are power of 2$$$2$$$. So she decided to fill the matrix in a way that the following conditions hold:
For each 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$, 1≤j≤n$$$1 \leq j \leq n$$$, Ai,j$$$A_{i,j}$$$ is an integer and 1≤Ai,j≤109$$$1 \leq A_{i,j} \leq 10^9$$$ holds
The sum of numbers in each row is a power of 2$$$2$$$ (that is, ∑nj=1Ai,j$$${\sum_{j=1}^n A_{i,j}}$$$ should be a power of 2$$$2$$$ for each 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$)
The sum of numbers in each column is a power of 2$$$2$$$ (that is, ∑ni=1Ai,j$$${\sum_{i=1}^n A_{i,j}}$$$ should be a power of 2$$$2$$$ for each 1≤j≤n$$$1 \leq j \leq n$$$)

The sum of numbers in each of the primary and secondary diagonals is a power of 2$$$2$$$ (that is, ∑ni=1Ai,i$$${\sum_{i=1}^n A_{i,i}}$$$ should be a power of 2$$$2$$$ and ∑ni=1Ai,n+1−i$$${\sum_{i=1}^n A_{i,n + 1 - i}}$$$ should be a power of 2$$$2$$$)
A number P$$$P$$$ is considered a power of 2$$$2$$$, if there is some integer i$$$i$$$(0≤i)$$$(0 \leq i)$$$, for which P=2i$$$P = 2^i$$$
Your task is to find any matrix of size n×n$$$n \times n$$$ satisfying these conditions or report that no such matrix exists.
input: The only line in the input contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤1000)$$$(1 \leq n \leq 1000)$$$.
output: If a solution exists, output n$$$n$$$ lines, each containing n$$$n$$$ integers in range [1,109]$$$[1, 10^9]$$$, the numbers of the matrix. Otherwise, output −1$$$-1$$$ on a single line.

legend.ai: Accidentally_Coder 是一位来自 CSEland 的知名程序员，她正陷入两难：她想给朋友 The_Author 送一份特别的礼物。思考了一会儿后，她去了自己最喜欢的 Zindabazar 商店，买了一个大小为 n×n$$$n \times n$$$ 的空矩阵 A$$$A$$$。她知道朋友喜欢 2 的幂$$$2$$$，于是决定以一种满足以下条件的方式填充这个矩阵：
对于每个 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$、1≤j≤n$$$1 \leq j \leq n$$$，Ai,j$$$A_{i,j}$$$ 都是整数，并且满足 1≤Ai,j≤109$$$1 \leq A_{i,j} \leq 10^9$$$。
每一行中数字的和都是 2 的幂$$$2$$$(也就是说，对于每个 1≤i≤n$$$1 \leq i \leq n$$$，∑nj=1Ai,j$$${\sum_{j=1}^n A_{i,j}}$$$ 都应当是 2 的幂$$$2$$$)。
每一列中各个数的和都是 2 的幂$$$2$$$(即，∑ni=1Ai,j$$${\sum_{i=1}^n A_{i,j}}$$$ 对于每个 1≤j≤n$$$1 \leq j \leq n$$$ 都应为 2 的幂$$$2$$$)
主对角线和副对角线上各个数的和都是 2 的幂$$$2$$$(即，∑ni=1Ai,i$$${\sum_{i=1}^n A_{i,i}}$$$ 应为 2 的幂$$$2$$$，且 ∑ni=1Ai,n+1−i$$${\sum_{i=1}^n A_{i,n + 1 - i}}$$$ 应为 2 的幂$$$2$$$)
你的任务是找到任意一个大小为 n×n$$$n \times n$$$ 且满足这些条件的矩阵，或者报告不存在这样的矩阵。

input.ai: 输入的唯一一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤1000$$$(1 \leq n \leq 1000)$$$)。

output.ai: 如果存在解，输出 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个范围在 [1,109]$$$[1, 10^9]$$$ 内的整数，即矩阵中的数。否则，在单独一行输出 −1$$$-1$$$。
